_about: Internal. Scenario roles of terminals and positions. Never give this file to participants.

TERM-01.role: Berths 7 and 8 hold MT Kalvora Star (VSL-0041) and MT Ostrel Bay (VSL-0042) from D-3. Cargo valves are opened remotely 04:00Z-05:30Z on D0; about 9,000 barrels spill here. Pre-storm drone sorties 4 and 5 (D-5, D-4) image this berth.

TERM-02.role: Quellmar (SUP-0390) terminal. Barge 44 (BRG-0044) delivers 380 m3 of transferred fuel here on D+32; the GPS interference transmitter JAM-01 sits in a parked vehicle in the industrial area beside it, D+38 to D+43.

TERM-07.role: MV Gulf Provider (VSL-0012) unloads 40 relief containers here on D+33; the Fort Hood aviation brigade loads the sealift ship (VSL-0019) here D+59 to D+64.

TERM-20.role: Tug Corrin Bay (VSL-0077) is repaired here after the D+44 blast (placement chosen in the registry pass; canon only says the tug was damaged).

HBR-ING.role: Motor yacht Narwhal Dream lies at 'Ingleside Marina Berth 7' (SLIP-ING-07) from D-12 to D-8 as the launch point for the pre-storm drone sorties.

TERM-08.role: Halcyon Drift (VSL-0031) loiters here from D-45; the 14-vessel Yankee queue holds here D-2 to D-1; storm-riding ships wait here D+3 to D+30; the AIS gap, the Pelican Ridge identity spoof and the transfer to Barge 44 happen here on D+30/31.

PILOT-BOARDING.role: DEV-01 and DEV-02 are laid about 2 nm off the entrance channel at 04:20Z on D+31 (EVT-0411); DEV-01 detonates beside Corrin Bay near the jetties at 06:10Z on D+44.

TERM-01.note: same name; moved from a made-up downtown point to real Inner Harbor docks

TERM-03.note: renamed La Quinta LNG Terminal (was 'CC LNG')

TERM-04.note: real refiner name removed; now the fictional Tule Lake Crude Terminal

TERM-05.note: real company name removed; now the fictional Viola Liquids Hub

TERM-06.note: renamed Avery Point Products Terminal (was 'Maxus Energy Terminal')

TERM-07.note: berths TERM-07-B01..B03 keep their ids; B04 added

TERM-08.note: now an anchorage area with ANCH-nn positions inside the real NOAA anchorage

TERM-09.note: 'Aransas Pass Entrance Channel Jetties' was not a terminal; use sea_buoy / pilot_boarding. The id TERM-09 is reused for La Quinta Bulk Liquids Terminal.

TERM-10.note: 'NAS Corpus Christi Fuel Farm' is not a marine terminal; it belongs in the infrastructure registry. The id TERM-10 is reused for La Quinta Dry Bulk Dock.

La Quinta Channel Berth 23.note: old Gulf Provider note; canon berths it at the Port of Corpus Christi on D+33
